offering_description.value: Owns and operates a fleet of dry bulk carrier vessels (mainly Panamax, Kamsarmax, Post-Panamax and Capesize) that transport iron ore, coal, grain and other commodities. Charters ships to commodity traders, miners, utilities and shipping operators on time charter and voyage contracts.

primary_services.value: seaborne dry bulk cargo transportation; time charter vessel hire; voyage charters

customer_segment.value: B2B: charterers such as commodity traders, miners, steel producers, grain merchants and utilities

end_markets.value: iron ore and steel; coal and energy; agriculture and grain; minerals and bulk commodities

revenue_model.value: service fees: time charter hire and voyage freight for carrying dry bulk cargo

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates dry bulk vessels built by shipyards, chartered to cargo owners and traders

geography_served.value: global: worldwide seaborne trade routes, Greece-based management, customers across Asia, Europe and the Americas

specialization.value: niche specialist: single line: ownership and chartering of dry bulk carriers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct charter contracts with charterers, sometimes via shipbrokers; agents / brokers: shipbrokers arranging charter fixtures

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: international shipping rules: IMO emissions and safety conventions, flag state and classification society requirements, sanctions

notes: Fleet mix and charter split are from general knowledge and may have changed.
